summary: The dashboard's core payoff: current net worth computed client-side from decrypted records, per-account balances with no staleness threshold, dimension grouping/breakdown, and a stacked SVG trend chart with per-account linear interpolation, asset/liability mirroring, and an estimated-data toggle.

read.role: decimal representation the total/interpolation arithmetic reuses
the only screen this feature drives

chart color/marker contract this feature must not deviate from, plus the hero-figure typography and no-count-up motion rule, the loading/empty/error defaults for the dashboard, and the shell it renders inside

dataFlow.value: on unlock, fetch all three record types once (GET /api/records?type=account|snapshot|profile), decrypt, build the in-memory model; subsequent writes update the model directly with no refetch

totalFormula.value: total = sum over active accounts of (latest snapshot.value * that snapshot.rate); 'latest' = greatest date, not most recently written

noStalenessThreshold.value: no threshold and no warning at any account age anywhere in this feature; age is stated in words, not flagged

noSnapshotsExcludedNotZero.value: an account with no snapshots contributes nothing and is listed as 'not yet valued', never shown as 0

interpolationRule.value: each account interpolated linearly between its own snapshots (each converted to main currency at its own stored rate) independently, then summed — never sum-then-interpolate; nothing before an account's first snapshot; carried forward after its last

bandPartitionRule.value: one band per dimension value, order fixed from the dimension's configured value order, never sorted by size; unassigned/unknown/archived-value entries fall into an 'Unassigned' band; no dimension selected = single 'Total' band

assetLiabilityMirroring.value: asset bands stack upward from zero, liability bands mirror downward in the same group color, net-worth line runs over the top

archivedAccountChartBehavior.value: contributes nothing after archivedAt; interpolates into the closing snapshot if one exists, otherwise drops at archivedAt; either way an annotation marks the date

chartRanges.value: 1M, 6M, 1Y, All; default 1Y, or All if history is shorter

percentageMode.value: asset bands normalized against total assets, liability bands against total liabilities, independently — never against the signed net figure

chartImplementation.value: hand-written SVG, no charting library; keyboard reachable with a data-table fallback; decrypted labels/tooltips via x-text/textContent only, never innerHTML/x-html or a library that takes an HTML string

noNetworkOnInteraction.value: switching range, dimension, absolute/percentage mode, or band visibility issues zero network requests — the whole model is already in memory

decryptionFailureHandling.value: a record that fails to decrypt is skipped, the rest of the view renders, and a prominent non-dismissible warning names the count

fixtures: three accounts in different units with known snapshots, for the hand-computed total-equality assertion
two accounts whose histories start years apart, for the per-account-interpolation-not-sum-first assertion
an account archived with and without a closing snapshot, for the two archived-account chart-behavior criteria
a deliberately corrupted record, for the decryption-failure warning criterion
an account/dimension-value label of `<script>alert(1)</script>`, for the XSS-rendering criterion across list, chart legend, and tooltip
focus: the interpolation criterion needs the sum-then-interpolate failure mode actually distinguished — assert the later account's first snapshot raises only its own band, not just that the final total is right
'the sum of the visible bands equals the net-worth line at that date' must be checked at multiple dates across the range, not just the endpoint
'no network request on interaction' requires intercepting actual network calls across range/dimension/mode/band-visibility changes, not inspecting the UI code for fetch calls
the decryption-failure warning must be non-dismissible and the count must be exact — a test that only checks a warning appears (without the count or dismissibility) is incomplete
chart color/marker assertions (band order, neutral-band fills, estimated ticks) should be checked against design-system.md's tables directly rather than re-deriving acceptable values
